name: Waydev AI
long_description:
Waydev tracks AI-generated code from commit to production. AI Checkpoints capture which agent wrote each change, tokens consumed, cost per PR, acceptance rate, and whether it actually deployed — so you can compare Copilot, Cursor, and Claude Code on real production outcomes, not vibes.

Engineering leaders use Waydev to measure AI adoption by team, monthly spend, and tokens per developer, then tie it back to delivery. The Waydev Agent answers plain-English questions about your AI investment ("which team gets the most ROI from Cursor?").

Built for VPs of Engineering and CTOs at companies running real AI coding budgets.

Trusted by Dropbox, American Express, Caterpillar, and PwC. YC W21.
one_liner: Track AI-generated code from commit to production
